evidence_pattern: High opportunity + evidence of capacity pressure
trigger: High Model V1 opportunity plus documented field/facility pressure or constrained availability
recommended_actions: Run facility/club capacity audit; map junior growth against playable ovals/nets; prioritise school/community facility sharing; sequence new programs only where delivery capacity exists; monitor waitlists/turnaways.
primary_metrics: Field hours available; club/team capacity; program waitlists; participants per playable oval; cancelled/declined team entries; facility utilisation.

trigger: High opportunity where new facilities/program capacity are coming online
recommended_actions: Launch/expand Blast and junior entry programs; partner with nearby schools; targeted girls recruitment; rapid club onboarding at new facilities; measure conversion from entry programs into junior club cricket.
primary_metrics: New registrations; first-year participants; Blast-to-club conversion; girls registrations; school-to-club conversion; utilisation of new facilities.

evidence_pattern: High demographic opportunity + incomplete cricket-demand evidence
trigger: Model ranks area highly but recent local participation evidence is weak or inconsistent
recommended_actions: Pull PlayHQ/registration history; survey clubs/schools; map current programs; test small pilot programs; compare participation growth with demographic growth before committing major capital.
primary_metrics: Registration growth; participation rate proxy; pilot conversion; club enquiry volume; school interest; participant travel distance.

trigger: Large current junior market but weaker or negative demographic momentum
recommended_actions: Prioritise retention, participant experience, year-to-year return and Blast/junior conversion; avoid assuming acquisition is the main problem.
primary_metrics: Return rate; churn; Blast-to-junior transition; season-to-season registration; satisfaction; volunteer stability.
case_examples: Candidate examples from Phase 10 include large slower-growth LGAs

evidence_pattern: Smaller market + rapid growth / high youth intensity
trigger: Strong growth/intensity but smaller current scale
recommended_actions: Establish low-cost entry programs and school links early; reserve facility capacity; monitor growth annually; avoid overbuilding before demand is validated.
primary_metrics: Junior population growth; entry registrations; local program availability; club capacity trend; facility pipeline.
